Fetched 2026-09-10: http://scdb.wustl.edu/index.php sha256 75961269b6f31c31329bb0ffac59f1ddc7985fb24f24f82280c818e7b2a0c731; http://scdb.wustl.edu/data.php sha256 9fabb229a65fc71fc45e90290334c2ab82eaaf91c04544d08310b6291594191d. Clean pass, with three things a reader needs to know. (1) The stimulus IS a word, so item_text repeats the item code verbatim: the IRW item is data/mturk_ddm.R's `x$test_word_string`, column 11 of the study's Experiment1.data on OSF za9y8, described there as 'the character string presented at test'. All 2202 words are lowercase in the source and are shipped exactly as the live table spells them. (2) resp is scored ACCURACY (1 = correct), not the key the participant pressed -- participants pressed '/' for 'on the list' and 'z' for 'not on the list' -- so option_text carries Incorrect/Correct, following twod_rotation_mather2023 and enkavi_2019_stroop. (3) correct_response is blank by necessity: studied/new status is randomised per subject and block, and 1326 of the 2202 words appear in the raw file under all three status codes, so 'was this word studied' is a property of the trial, not of the item.
